Featuring interviews and segments with filmmakers and critics such as Paul Thomas Anderson, Edgar Wright, Brad Bird, Martin Scorsese, and Steven Spielberg, the series uses archival clips and expert commentary to show how landmark films shaped culture and industry. Each episode focuses on a specific decade, tracing technological, artistic, and social developments in film. The tone is nostalgic and informative, aimed at both cinephiles and viewers interested in cultural history.

properties.description: Once Upon a Time... in Hollywood (2019), written and directed by Quentin Tarantino and starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Brad Pitt, and Margot Robbie, is a comedy-drama set in Los Angeles in 1969. It follows a fading television actor and his stunt double as they try to adapt to a changing industry, intersecting with real and fictional figures from the era. The film is an episodic, character-driven meditation on fame, friendship, obsolescence, and the nostalgic mythmaking of Hollywood, delivered with Tarantino’s trademark mix of sharp dialogue and sudden violence.
